title: Deviation from a θ-median is controlled by the double-integral oscillation (Simon Ch. 2, 2.7; parent step 3)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ Euclid P measurable with L(W) := volume(W) < ∞, v : Euclid P → ℝ integrable on W, β ∈ ℝ and θ > 0 with θ·L(W) ≤ L(W ∩ {β ≤ v}) and θ·L(W) ≤ L(W ∩ {v ≤ β}) (real numbers via toReal). Then ∫_W |v − β| ≤ (1 + θ⁻¹)·L(W)⁻¹·∫_W ∫_W |v(x) − v(y)| dy dx, where 0⁻¹ := 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (v : Euclid P → ℝ) (β θ : ℝ), MeasurableSet W → volume W ≠ ∞ → IntegrableOn v W → 0 < θ → θ * (volume W).toReal ≤ (volume (W ∩ {y | β ≤ v y})).toReal → θ * (volume W).toReal ≤ (volume (W ∩ {y | v y ≤ β})).toReal → ∫ y in W, |v y - β| ≤ (1 + θ⁻¹) * ((volume W).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ x in W, ∫ y in W, |v x - v y|
